honor a promise: A good leader should always honor a promise, even when keeping it becomes difficult or costly.
一位好的領導者應該永遠信守承諾，即使遵守它變得困難或代價高昂。
honor a contract: If the company refuses to honor a contract that it has already signed, it may have to pay a large fine.
如果公司拒絕履行已經簽署的合約，可能必須支付一大筆罰款。
honor the dead: Every year on this day, people gather at the memorial to honor the dead who lost their lives in the war.
每年的這一天，人們都會聚集在紀念碑前，緬懷在戰爭中喪生的亡者。
be honored to: I will be honored to accept this award on behalf of all the volunteers who worked so hard this year.
我很榮幸能代表今年所有辛勤付出的志工接受這個獎項。
in honor of: The school planted a cherry tree in honor of the teacher who had taught there for forty years.
學校種了一棵櫻花樹，為紀念那位在此任教四十年的老師。
be hooked on games: Many parents worry that their kids will be hooked on games and spend less time studying or playing outside.
許多家長擔心孩子會沉迷遊戲，花在讀書或戶外玩耍的時間變少。
hook up with: When you arrive in Taipei, try to hook up with some local students who can show you around the city.
你到了台北後，試著聯繫上一些當地學生，他們可以帶你在城裡四處逛逛。
hook the audience: A good speaker often tells a funny story at the start to hook the audience and keep them interested.
好的演講者常在開頭講個有趣的故事，以吸引觀眾並讓他們保持興趣。
off the hook: The teacher let me off the hook this time, but she warned me never to be late for class again.
老師這次讓我脫身了，但她警告我以後上課絕不能再遲到。
by hook or by crook: He was determined to get a ticket to the sold-out concert by hook or by crook.
他下定決心要不擇手段弄到那場門票已售罄的演唱會的票。
host a party: We plan to host a party at our house next Saturday to celebrate my parents' wedding anniversary.
我們打算下星期六在家裡辦派對，慶祝我父母的結婚紀念日。
host the Olympics: Many cities compete for the chance to host the Olympics because the event brings tourists and money.
許多城市爭取主辦奧運的機會，因為這項盛事能帶來觀光客和財富。
host a show: The famous comedian was invited to host a show on TV every Friday night starting next month.
那位知名喜劇演員受邀從下個月起每週五晚上在電視上主持節目。
host a website: Our school rents space on a server to host a website, so parents can check news and schedules online.
我們學校租用伺服器空間來架設網站，讓家長可以在線上查看消息和行事曆。
house refugees: The government built new shelters near the border to house refugees who had fled the war.
政府在邊境附近蓋了新的收容所，以安置逃離戰爭的難民。
the museum houses: The museum houses more than ten thousand ancient paintings, many of which are shown only once a year.
這座博物館收藏了一萬多幅古畫，其中許多每年只展出一次。
house a collection: The new library was built to house a collection of rare books donated by a famous local writer.
新圖書館的興建是為了收藏一位知名在地作家所捐贈的珍貴書籍。
house the homeless: During the cold winter months, the city opened an old school building to house the homeless.
在寒冷的冬季月份，市政府開放一棟舊校舍來收容遊民。
hover around 3%: The unemployment rate has continued to hover around 3% for the past two years, which is quite low.
過去兩年來，失業率一直徘徊在3%左右，算是相當低。
hover between life and death: After the terrible car accident, the young driver continued to hover between life and death for several days.
那場嚴重車禍之後，年輕駕駛連續好幾天都徘徊在生死邊緣。
hover over someone: Please don't hover over someone while they are taking a test, because it makes them nervous.
別人考試時請不要在旁盯著，因為這會讓他們緊張。
a helicopter hovers: A helicopter hovers above the burning building, staying in one spot while firefighters are lifted to safety.
一架直升機在燃燒的大樓上方盤旋，停在原地讓消防員被吊升到安全的地方。
hug the coast: The small fishing boat tried to hug the coast so it could reach a harbor quickly if a storm came.
那艘小漁船試著沿著海岸航行，這樣如果暴風雨來襲就能很快進港。
hug the shore: Beginners should hug the shore when kayaking, staying close to land in case they get tired.
初學者划獨木舟時應該貼近岸邊，靠近陸地以免體力不支。
hug the wall: In the narrow, crowded alley, we had to hug the wall to let the scooters pass by safely.
在狹窄擁擠的巷子裡，我們必須貼牆走，好讓機車安全通過。
bear hug: When my grandfather saw me at the airport, he ran over and gave me a big bear hug.
我爺爺在機場看到我時，跑過來給了我一個大大的熊抱。
hum with activity: On the night before the festival, the whole market seemed to hum with activity as vendors set up their stalls.
節慶前一晚，攤販們忙著擺攤，整個市場似乎都忙碌熱鬧起來。
hum a tune: My grandmother likes to hum a tune from her childhood while she cooks dinner in the kitchen.
我奶奶喜歡一邊在廚房煮晚餐，一邊哼著她童年時的歌。
the engine hums: When you start this new electric car, the engine hums so quietly that you can barely hear it.
當你發動這輛新電動車時，引擎嗡嗡作響的聲音小到你幾乎聽不見。
hum and haw: When I asked my brother where he had been all night, he began to hum and haw instead of answering.
當我問弟弟整晚去了哪裡時，他開始支吾其詞，而不是直接回答。
